supported_fields.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 95 — Super 17, the Ultimate Android
supported_fields.mechanics: Other Super used by Super 17 that creates an energy-draining field while evading attacks; community testing reports absorption of incoming Ki-based attacks and Ki return. Exact current game-data resource cost remains unresolved.

limits: No hidden Ultimate-Finish-only gate is inferred where the evidence does not establish one.
evidence_summary: Current/maintained evidence confirms PQ95 and Basic Reward placement. Community reports document RNG acquisition and differing Ultimate-Finish interpretations; the repository should preserve the evidence boundary rather than asserting a guaranteed drop or exact probability.
